record.question: Comment on the following: (a) A competent authority altered the kind of leave due and applied for without the consent of the Govt. servant. (b) A Govt. servant recalled to duty before the expiry of his leave claims travelling allowance for the journey he performed for his headquarters. (c) A controlling authority insists that an application for half pay leave should be supported by medical certificate. (d) A Govt. servant who is having 20 days half pay leave at his credit applied for leave not due on medical ground. (e) A male Govt. servant with less than two surviving children applied for paternity leave only after three months his wife had delivered a child.
